Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.shape

package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.shape
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.geysermc.paletter.internal
     
  • Class
    Description
    ShapeTransformation
    What a block's minecraft:transformation does to its culling shape, as BDS computes it (in single precision, in this order; captured with the shapes of the probe add-on of voxel-shapes capture, on edges that are no binary fractions so that every rounding shows): scale, if any factor is not 1: (v - c) * s + c on every axis, c = 0.5 + scale pivot; rotation: the quarter turns around x, then y, then z, as one change of axes.
    VoxelGrid
    A voxel shape as Bedrock keeps and sends it: per axis the sorted coordinates of a grid (in blocks), and which of the cells between them are filled.
    VoxelShapeCompiler
    Builds the voxel shape registry of a palette the way BDS builds its own (data/bds/WIRE-NOTES.md, "Voxel shapes"): the named vanilla shapes, in the order of the bundled capture; the custom shapes in the order they were registered (BDS: the order of their file names).
    VoxelShapeRules
    What BDS refuses in a voxel shape file, with its own words (content log of the probe add-on of voxel-shapes capture, data/bds/<build>/voxel-shapes/content-log.txt; the limit on the extent is a text of the BDS binary that no capture reached).
    VoxelShapeStore
    The bundled voxel shape registries of vanilla Bedrock (voxel_shapes.nbt): per data version the shapes BDS sends a client of a world without add-ons, in its order (and, where it differs, of a world with the experiment "voxel_shapes").
    VoxelShapeStore.Entry
    One shape of a vanilla registry; its position in the list is its id.
